notes.title: September Update 1 - Bug Fixes and QoL
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613599/7800fdabebb3f5a8801183a35301cacc49cf8c5c.png"]


🔧 Demo Fixes & Improvements
Store/Inventory: selection frame now stays visible when buying, selling, or using items.

Ivy clones: no longer give scaling rewards (no more 12+ million Dust per battle!).

Poison spell: description updated to show it deals 10–15% of current HP per tick.

Coins: can now be sold in the store, with a small supply always available.

Equipped items: no more accidental selling of equipped items if you own duplicates.

Damage Nullify skill: now has a clear visual effect when it triggers.




Full Game Progress


Boss battles for the second and third maps have been set up in prototype form. The game can now be played through to the final boss, though there’s still lots of work left to do.

Progress made on a new enemy, our mysterious bat girl. She’ll spread her wings, claw, and drain you if you’re not careful. For now, we’re calling her Batsy, but we’d love to hear your name suggestions.

notes.title: Demo Update – Balance, QoL & Sneak Peek at Full Game Progress
notes.content:
We’ve rolled out a new demo update based on your feedback! This one focuses on smoothing out rough edges, improving pacing, and toning down some over-tuned mechanics.


⚔️ Balance Changes



Ivy + Doe combo

No more Ivy + Doe right at the start. Early fights will be gentler, giving you time to gather Dust and learn the ropes.

Doe: HP reduced by ~15%, healing power reduced by 30%.

Ivy: Clones are now weaker (about 50% of Ivy’s strength), with a distinct name and color.

Luck scaling

Luck was too strong and felt mandatory.

Effect reduced by 25%, but enemy rewards increased by 25% to keep progression steady.

Enemy boost after boss

The old system doubled enemy stats after the demo boss, which felt like scaling.

This boost has been removed. Enemies now stay consistent throughout the demo.
[hr][/hr]
🎲 QoL & Gameplay Flow

Foxy’s Wheel

Spin duration reduced by 30% (still suspenseful, but less waiting).

Ambush results now return you directly to Foxy, skipping the node map detour.

First Mimic chest

The very first chest is now always safe. Later chests can still be Mimics, because that false sense of safety is part of the fun. Start New Game to avoid inconsistencies.

Ivy’s pace

Her movement speed has been doubled to reduce the sluggish feel of her walk cycle.

Sound settings

Volume controls added to both the starting screen and active scene.

Fine-tuning of individual sounds is still underway, but now you have general control everywhere.
[hr][/hr]

 🔮 Full Game Progress Sneak Peek

While polishing the demo, we’ve also advanced work on the full release:

Map transitions: after a boss, you’ll move into new maps with fresh enemies, events, challenges, story beats, and bosses.

Hard battle nodes: the shield icon will mark special high-difficulty encounters with bigger rewards.
[hr][/hr]
🛠️ Minor Fixes
Pause menu no longer overlaps with options (no more accidental “Quit to Desktop”).

Victory screen now auto-focuses and can be skipped with a single click.

Fair Trade event bug fixed (trading 0 MP no longer leaves you at 1 MP).

Skip rewards screen can be triggered even quicker.

Death screen duration reduced
[hr][/hr]

Thank you all for the continued feedback, it’s helping us shape Twiwood Tales into something better with every update. Keep sharing your thoughts, and we’ll keep listening!

notes.title: Demo Patch Update – New Tutorial, Balance Fixes & QoL Improvements
notes.content:
We’ve just pushed out a fresh update to the Twiwood Tales demo! This patch focuses on improving the early experience, balancing enemies and rewards, and making things smoother overall based on your feedback.

Highlights:

New Tutorial

Added a tutorial for menus (can be skipped or replayed anytime).

Combat Flow

Defend now drains stamina when held.

Victory Screen and Boss intro can now be skipped.

Sound Settings

Added volume controls to the Pause menu (coming to other menus soon).

Balance Changes

Enemies no longer scale with player level.

Items, rewards, and enemies rebalanced.

Extra challenge unlocked after Boss defeat (tougher enemies & rewards).

Gear

New shield added to Foxy’s rewards.

QoL Improvements

Level Up button always visible.

Foxy stays in her intended position after affection is maxed.

Nodes map now flashes a Dust icon when you have enough Dust to level up.

Luck Factor

Luck now influences Steal technique.


For best result, start New Game

Thanks for all the feedback so far, it’s been shaping the demo in the right direction!
Keep playing, keep letting us know what feels good (or doesn’t).

notes.title: Demo Patch, Ivy’s New Style & Interface Updates
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613599/3d2ccf5e7a8d8aacb3de4447c1767319a483fa1c.png"]


 It seems the Twiwood Forest was a little too hot for Ivy’s previous outfit, so she’s back with a fresh new look!

We’ve also been working on making the interface more intuitive:

Added Visible scroll to Techniques & Magic tabs for easier navigation.

Techniques tab now includes a sneak peek at a few upcoming techniques.

Magic tab now displays available spells more clearly.

As always, thanks for all the feedback and bug reports. It’s helping us make Twiwood Tales better with each update!

notes.title: Demo Patch, Technique Fixes & Pause Menu Update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45613599/3d2ccf5e7a8d8aacb3de4447c1767319a483fa1c.png"]

Fixed:

Punitor Natium technique could be learned multiple times.

Side improvement branches for Punitor Natium were not purchasable.

Changes:

Punitor Natium – Speed upgrades → now changed to Duration upgrades.

Each level adds +3 seconds of technique performance time.

All levels together = +15 seconds total, on top of HST scaling.

Punitor Natium – Damage upgrades:

Each level adds +10% total slap damage.

All levels together = +50% total damage, on top of STR scaling.

Other Improvements:

Pause menu can now be closed with the Esc key.
